journey.name: Starter: counter on-chain happy path
journey.description:
Every contract call the quickstart has. counter.compact exports one circuit, `increment`, so a run that deploys and increments has covered the contract.
This is the first on-chain thing anyone following the published quickstart does, which makes it the worst place for a silent regression. The other starter journeys stop at the sigil-less screen, before proving, dust-fee balancing or submission — where every failure found on a real device actually lives.
The app may arrive already holding a deployment: its contract address is part of the app state restored from the cloud, so a fresh install of a wallet that has deployed before comes up Deployed rather than Ready. Both are valid starting points and the journey allows either; what it will not accept is a count that does not move.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony, and kuira.blockfrost.projectId, so PreProd answers at all; - that wallet funded on PreProd, with dust registered.
A wallet with no checkpoint on this device spends several minutes syncing dust before the call can pay its fee, and sits on "Balancing dust fee…" throughout. That happens once per wallet per app.
Verified end to end on PreProd 2026-10-24: increment proved in 0.12s, balanced against the wallet's dust, submitted, finalized, and the on-screen count advanced.

actions.action: If the screen shows a "Deploy counter" control, tap it and verify the screen then shows "Deployed at:"
Note the counter value currently shown
Verify the screen shows an "Increment" control
Verify the screen shows "Count updates live from chain."
Verify the counter value shown is one higher than the noted value
Verify the screen does NOT show "Last error:"
